records.title: Florida RN initial licensure: selected examination-path steps
records.overview: Selected regulator-sourced steps for Florida nursing licensure by examination. Education alternatives are conditional; this summary omits other individual eligibility, endorsement, criminal or disciplinary, exemption and examination-history circumstances. Always consult the Board directly. Learning App cannot issue a nursing license or determine eligibility.
records.review_note: Reviewed against the Florida Board of Nursing RN and LPN examination application page on October 12, 2026. The board describes alternative education qualifications, fingerprints, application, NCLEX eligibility and license issuance as distinct stages. Selected steps only; individual exceptions are not fully covered.

children.label: Graduate from a Florida-approved or accredited nursing education program
Graduate from an ACEN- or CCNE-accredited nursing program with an NCSBN-issued NCLEX code
Graduate from a recognized nursing program in another jurisdiction that has an NCSBN-issued NCLEX code
Graduate from an international or non-NCSBN program that the Board determines equivalent
children.condition: Requires a Board equivalency determination and additional documentation

children.label: Graduate from a pre-licensure MSN or higher program with an NCSBN-issued NCLEX code
Provide the applicable education documentation to the Florida Board of Nursing
Complete the required electronic fingerprinting and Level 2 background screening
Submit the initial licensure-by-examination application and required fees
Obtain the Board's approval for NCLEX eligibility and take the NCLEX examination
children.condition: Applicable to applicants who have not previously passed the NCLEX

children.label: Receive the state nursing license only after passing the NCLEX and meeting all licensing criteria
